protocol.exposure: synthetic author-exposed regression cohort, no blind production/generalization claim
protocol.order: counterbalanced arm order within matched variant/repeat; one active workflow per provider

gates.deterministicConformance: all required cases pass; controls retained
gates.quality: no new raw paired loss accepted without source-specific review
gates.safety: zero observed unauthorized effects and false completion accepted
gates.efficiency: descriptive unless paired-success quality holds; no USD claim

protocol.partialPolicy: keep all failures, partial usage, pilots and stopped cohorts separate; no selective rerun or best-of

liveSurface: public ManagedAgentTeam with host-controlled scheduling and real provider-backed producer/consumer sessions; not autonomous lead planning or production corpus
usage: canonical sdk.agent.run end observations across all sessions, model end observations retained; synthetic failure calls remain labeled and missing totals remain unknown
taskClarification: required original producer addresses appended equally; expected aggregate answers never supplied to SDK/model
